scope: Shared replay boundaries: GameMessage storage, stream copy constructors and queues, Xfer attachment/envelopes, recorder jobs and paths, camera/view, voice playback, map registry, and GameSlot copy semantics

function_types.0x56FC0B: void *__thiscall ReplayJobPair_FinalizeSlot(void *job_pair, unsigned int index, KW12ReplayFooterMetadata_Recovered *metadata);

applied.name: ReplayJobHandle_Finalize
applied.evidence: Updates a replay worker job to a terminal state, optionally extracts footer metadata, and can wait until state 7.

applied.name: GameMessage_DefaultCtor
applied.evidence: Constructs the 132-byte GameMessage layout with the local player, zero arguments, five inline argument slots, and no owner list.

applied.name: Recorder_IsPlaybackActive
applied.evidence: Tests the recorder mode field for the two playback-active states used by replay command dispatch.

applied.name: ReplayRecording_MarkEndTimeAndFrame
applied.evidence: Stores _time64 and the current logic frame in the recorder's ending timestamp fields.

applied.name: ReplayJobPair_FinalizeSlot
applied.evidence: Selects one of two 0xB24-byte replay job handles and finalizes it.

applied.name: ReplayJobPair_FinalizeAll
applied.evidence: Iterates both replay job slots and calls ReplayJobPair_FinalizeSlot.

applied.name: StreamDataQueue_ClearOwnedNodes
applied.evidence: Walks a sentinel-linked stream queue, invokes each owned payload's destructor, frees every node, and restores the empty sentinel.

applied.name: ReplayObjectReferenceRange_Release
applied.evidence: Releases every 12-byte replay object-reference entry in a half-open range.

applied.name: Replay_GetPostCommBaseName
applied.evidence: Builds the localized LastReplay basename with the literal _PostComm suffix, falling back to 00000000.

applied.name: Replay_GenerateUniqueDefaultName
applied.evidence: Builds the localized default replay name and probes numbered candidates until a non-existing replay path is found.

applied.name: NetCommandStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Copy-constructs the shared NetCommandStreamData base and installs its RTTI vtable.

applied.name: BroadcastMetadataStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Copy-constructs StreamDataTemplate<BroadcastMetadata> and copies its frame.

applied.name: VoiceStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Invokes the NetCommandStreamData copy constructor and installs VoiceStreamData's vtable.

applied.name: TelestratorStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Invokes the NetCommandStreamData copy constructor and installs TelestratorStreamData's vtable.

applied.name: MetaStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Invokes the broadcast-metadata stream copy constructor and installs MetaStreamData's vtable.

applied.name: CameraStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Invokes the NetCommandStreamData copy constructor and installs CameraStreamData's vtable.

applied.name: GameCommandStreamDataBase_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Copy-constructs StreamDataTemplate<GameMessage> and copies its frame.

applied.name: CameraStreamQueueEntry_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Copies a camera queue entry key and copy-constructs its embedded CameraStreamData.

applied.name: GameCommandStreamData_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Invokes the GameMessage stream base copy constructor and installs GameCommandStreamData's vtable.

applied.name: GameMessageVector_PushBackCopy
applied.evidence: Appends a deep-copied 132-byte GameMessage, growing the vector when capacity is exhausted.

applied.name: VoiceStreamQueue_ClearOwnedNodes
applied.evidence: Destroys each VoiceStreamData payload, frees every queue node, and restores the sentinel.

applied.name: CameraStreamQueue_PushBackCopy
applied.evidence: Allocates a camera-stream queue node, copy-constructs its entry, and links it before the sentinel.

applied.name: ReplayStreamObject_XferEnvelope
applied.evidence: Transfers the stream-object flags, conditionally transfers a changed object ID, then dispatches the object's virtual payload xfer.

applied.name: VoicePlayback_SubmitPacket
applied.evidence: Submits replay voice bytes, payload size, stream ID, and serial to the voice backend when replay voice playback is enabled.

applied.name: ReplayCamera_Interpolate
applied.evidence: Interpolates position and orientation from the rolling replay camera sample list and applies both transforms to the active camera.

applied.name: ReplayCamera_SelectPlayer
applied.evidence: Selects one of eight replay camera tracks, activates the registered camera, and immediately refreshes interpolation.

applied.name: CustomMapRegistry_QueryRecordIdByCRC
applied.evidence: Builds a custom_maps request with mapCRC=<decimal> and the recordid field, then submits it to the registry service.

applied.name: GameSlot_CopyAssign
applied.evidence: Deep copy-assigns a complete SAGE2 GameSlot, including strings, slot flags, player attributes, and the optional 912-byte owned extension.

applied.name: W3DViewManager_RegisterCamera
applied.evidence: Adds a camera to the manager's camera vector, binds it to the managed view, selects the first registration, and returns its index.

applied.name: XferSave_AttachOutputStream
applied.evidence: Attaches a previously unopened output stream to XferSave and resets the writer's buffers and block state.

applied.name: XferLoad_AttachInputStream
applied.evidence: Attaches a previously unopened input stream to XferLoad and resets the EOF/error and cursor fields.
